subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as a plugin/API-driven status contribution seam, a core TUI config/template surface, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request is useful but spans public config, TUI rendering, provider credentials/usage APIs, and Plugin SDK contracts; automation cannot safely choose the long-term product boundary.

options.title: Plugin/API-First Footer Seam
options.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI render integration and provider-usage fields after maintainers approve API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy.

options.title: Core Footer Template Config
options.body: Add first-class `tui` footer template/config support, accepting the compatibility and migration burden of a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep Existing Status Surfaces
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and decline persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-First Footer Seam
recommendation.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI render integration and provider-usage fields after maintainers approve API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history match across TUI footer behavior, provider usage/status surfaces, and plugin architecture decisions.
